The armor includes a breastplate, pauldrons (shoulder guards), faulds (waist protection), gauntlets, and greaves (leg armor). The breastplate is the central focus, featuring a high gloss finish with visible reflections. To the left and right foreground, parts of other armor pieces (possibly helmets or shields) are visible.
